versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- Documentation updated in SKILL.md: minor revision to Locale description (now clarifies both default Chinese and optional English interaction).
- No changes to functionality or behavior; this update is limited to documentation and file cleanup.

- Adds anonymous trial mode: you can run up to 5 full cloud-scored checks with a local anon_id before registering for a Key.
- Registration for a free API Key (100 calls) is only needed after the 5-trial limit.
- No changes to the check items or core logic.
- No credential collection in the terminal; local anon_id and API Key files use secure permissions.
- One removed file: stale Python bytecode cache deleted.

- Removed obsolete skill-card.md documentation file.
- Added compiled Python cache file (scripts/__pycache__/ccpa-check.cpython-313.pyc).
- No functional or behavioral changes to the ccpa-check skill itself.

- The bundled sample file skill-card.md was removed.
- Documentation updated to clarify: the free --non-interactive preview now uses only bundled check items and never contacts the cloud; a scored run fetches the latest items from the cloud.
- No other functional or API changes.

- Removed all in-terminal credential collection; API Key is now obtained via browser registration only.
- Updated setup instructions: users register at compliancehub.cn/account.html to get their Key, which must be set via environment variable or key file.
- No email or password is ever entered into the terminal or handled by the skill.
- Locale and guidance updated to highlight Chinese-language support (zh-CN).
- Removed two files: scripts/__pycache__/ccpa-check.cpython-313.pyc and skill-card.md.

Version 2.0.3

- Updated name references from “ChengQianZhiLian cloud” to “CQDev cloud”.
- Clarified security and data handling—explicitly notes no shell execution, no arbitrary OS commands, and no autonomous agent behavior.
- Expanded details on API key storage: now specifies that key is only written when running --login, as a user-initiated action.
- Added permissions section specifying network, filesystem, and environment variable usage.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Clarified that cloud scoring sends user answers to compliancehub.cn; detailed privacy and data handling procedures.
- Updated triggers and usage examples for improved clarity.
- Revised agent guidance to specify when to use the skill.
- Added an explicit “Security & data handling” section, including API key storage details and server endpoints.
- Minor edits for accuracy in API key instructions and storage location.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of ccpa-check skill (v1.0.0)
- Provides a free, cloud-scored compliance check based on CCPA and CPRA, covering 12 core requirements.
- Includes a preview mode listing check items without an API key.
- Free to install; scoring and reports require a free API key (100 calls) from compliancehub.cn.
- Designed for businesses needing to assess California consumer privacy compliance.
